<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This is an </nowiki><strong><nowiki>advanced guide</nowiki></strong><nowiki> which assumes a strong underlying knowledge of all mechanics and information presented in </nowiki><span><nowiki>#raksha-basic</nowiki></span><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>

</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-1"><ins><nowiki>Method 1</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Use this method if you have War's Blessing 4 unlocked.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=6f6b6ce6-520d-41fd-a2fd-f83a2d25668f <nowiki>Ranged - Method 1</nowiki>]<nowiki>
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2F6f6b6ce6-520d-41fd-a2fd-f83a2d25668f.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<blockquote><nowiki>
</nowiki><p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>This rotation averages 1:04 - 1:10 kill times.</nowiki></em></p><nowiki>
</nowiki></blockquote>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Stalling </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478061864943616122.png?v=1" alt="galeshot" title="galeshot" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is optional.</nowiki></p>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/543478434953822208.png?v=1" alt="veng" title="veng" kind="icon" /><nowiki> throughout the fight.</nowiki></p>

</nowiki>
